title: Chapter 2731: Ninth Heaven
content:
Chapter 2731: Ninth Heaven

When Yuan arrived at the Nameless Stairway, he was greeted by a familiar scene.

Several people, who were clearly blacksmiths, were gathered around the treasure, inspecting it.

However, unlike before, they didn’t block the entrance, merely inspecting the treasure from the sides.

Ever since Yuan’s incident with the Indestructible Steel Association, the entire organization had been plagued by difficulties no one could have imagined.

Because Yuan had barred every member of the association from using the Nameless Stairway, their blacksmiths had only two options if they wanted to travel through the Nine Heavens. Either leave the association or journey through the starry sky.

Due to the nature of their profession, traveling throughout the Nine Heavens was both common and often necessary. However, this restriction confined the blacksmiths to their own realm, severely limiting their opportunities.

With no other choice, the Indestructible Steel Association was forced to make special exceptions for its blacksmiths, allowing them to temporarily leave the association whenever they needed to travel throughout the Nine Heavens.

However, they had to rejoin within a certain period of time. Otherwise, they would be permanently removed and forced to go through the entire joining process again from the beginning.

Although the arrangement was tedious and inconvenient, it was the only way the association could keep its numbers from dwindling too much and remain in control.

Of course, they had sought help from the Celestial Emperor, but he seemed far more interested in Yuan’s name than in their predicament.

In response to the blacksmiths’ complaints, the Celestial Emperor revealed that he still intended to install the replacement he had originally planned during the Stairway to Heaven’s disappearance.

After all, even though the Stairway to Heaven had already been replaced by the Nameless Stairway, the Celestial Emperor had no control over it. Moreover, he had long wanted to replace the Stairway to Heaven with one under his own authority but had never been given the opportunity, so he wasn’t about to abandon his plans so easily.

The Indestructible Steel Association was ecstatic upon hearing the news. However, since the replacement was still under development, they had no choice but to endure their current predicament for a little longer.

Shortly after their arrival, Yuan and Mu Xuelian approached the Nameless Stairway. However, when they got close, someone approached them and asked, "Are you going to use the stairway?"

"Why are you asking?" Yuan questioned with a suspicious look.

"The Celestial Emperor has mandated that everyone using the stairway must be logged, so if you plan on using it, we’ll need to verify your identity."

Yuan raised an eyebrow and continued asking, "Since when did this become a thing?"

"Yesterday."

"And what if we refuse?"

"Well... we’d have to report you to Heaven’s Mandate."

"And how are you going to do that without knowing my identity?" Yuan said with a smile.

"Do you really want to find out the hard way?" The man calmly shook his head, having encountered plenty of people like Yuan in a single day.

"I don’t suggest it," another voice suddenly said.

Yuan turned to look at the man who’d just spoken.

"This isn’t a simple rule, but a Heavenly Law," the man explained.

Heavenly Laws are rules every living being in the Nine Heavens must obey, and disobeying them would trigger Heavenly Judgment.

’The Celestial Emperor made it into a Heavenly Law? He must be looking for someone... and quite desperate, too,’ Yuan smiled inwardly.

He looked at the man who’d asked for his identity and asked, "How do you want me to confirm my identity?"

The man retrieved a scroll and said, "A drop of your blood."

The next moment, Yuan produced a single drop of blood and fed it to the scroll without the slightest hesitation.

Although doing so could potentially expose his presence to the Celestial Emperor, Yuan wasn’t worried in the slightest. In fact, he no longer had any intention of hiding from him.

’If he comes after me, then so be it...’ Yuan smiled inwardly, almost hoping that would happen.

The scroll consumed Yuan’s blood, and soon, information appeared on it.

The man raised an eyebrow after seeing the information.

"You’re a Player?" he said aloud.

"Does that change anything?" Yuan asked, surprised it even identified him as a Player, since he’d been kicked off the system long ago.

"A little," the man said, not bothering to elaborate.

He then handed Yuan a small jade token and said, "Make sure you’re carrying this when you use the stairway."

Yuan accepted the token and waited for Mu Xuelian to verify her identity.

Once Mu Xuelian provided her blood, the man waited for the scroll to show her information.

"Huh. How strange. Nothing is showing up for you," he said a moment later when the scroll remained blank.

Sorry, but unless you can provide another means of verifying your identity, I can’t allow you to use the stairway."

"..."

Mu Xuelian didn’t even bother to argue with the man and turned to Yuan.

"Gates of Heaven, right? I’ll meet you there," she said.

"Don’t tell me you’re going to traverse through the starry sky."

Mu Xuelian calmly nodded at Yuan’s question.

Then, without another word, Mu Xuelian flew away.

"..."

Yuan watched her swiftly vanish into the sky, not bothering to stop her.

Some time later, Yuan entered the Nameless Stairway.

The interior of the Nameless Stairway was the exact same as the Stairway to Heaven.

"Take me to the Ninth Heaven," he commanded the treasure.

The next moment, a set of semi-transparent stairs materialized before Yuan, stretching upward into the distance.

Yuan calmly climbed the stairs.

One step... ten steps... a hundred steps...

Two hundred steps later, a single door stood at the end of the stairs.

Yuan opened the door and stepped inside, vanishing into the void.

<You have arrived at the Ninth Heaven>

"At last, I’ve reached the Ninth Heaven..." Yuan muttered, memories of when he first began his journey in the Lower Heavens flashing through his mind.

After so many years, he had finally ascended from the Lower Heavens to the Supreme Heaven.
